_about: Serial numbers and components of RCA hardware that papers, web pages and documents give, outside OOI asset-management. Each entry was read in its source; every quote must appear word for word in the named corpus chunk, or build_asset_metadata.py stops. Each entry becomes its own chunk, cited to its own source.

entries.subject: Cabled Self-Calibrating Pressure Recorder (CSCPR) at the Central Caldera, as described for 2018-2021
facts: Its two quartz pressure gauges are a Paroscientific model 44.4K, serial number 136576, and a Paroscientific model 46K, serial number 132123.
The gauges are sampled at 1 Hz by Paroscientific model 1764 logging electronics.
The cabled system is nearly identical internally to the SCPR of Sasagawa and Zumberge (2013), in a titanium pressure case, powered and connected by the RCA.

quotes.text: Two Paroscientific gauges (model 44.4K SN 136576 and model 46K SN132123) are sampled with Paroscientific model 1764 logging electronics at 1 Hz.
The CSCPR system is nearly identical internally to the one described in Sasagawa and Zumberge (2013)
The OOI RCA provides power and communications to the CSCPR
The upgraded CSCPR has a titanium pressure case

source.citation: Sasagawa, G. S., Zumberge, M. A., & Cook, M. J. (2023). Drift Corrected Seafloor Pressure Observations of Vertical Deformation at Axial Seamount 2018–2021. Earth and Space Science, 10(2), e2022EA002434.

entries.subject: SCPR unit 001, deployed at Axial Seamount in 2013-2014 on a short mooring, before the cabled SCPR
facts: SCPR unit 001 had two Paroscientific model 410K pressure gauges, serial numbers 116504 and 118710.

It was deployed at Axial Seamount on 7 September 2013 with ROV Jason, as a short mooring at a depth of 1541 m, at 45.93438°N, 130.01178°W, in the summit caldera NE of the ASHES vent field (RCA Atlas note: the paper's text reads 130.01178°E; its minus sign was lost in extraction, and the site is west of Greenwich).

quotes.text: The SCPR incorporates two Paroscientiﬁc pressure gauges (model 410 K, serial numbers 116504 and 118710).
It was deployed at Axial Seamount on 7 September 2013 at 45.93438°N,

and at a depth of 1541 m as a short mooring with ﬂotation with the assistance of the ROV Jason. The deployment site is in the summit caldera NE of the Axial Seamount Hydrothermal Emissions Study (ASHES) hydrothermal

source.citation: Sasagawa, G., Cook, M. J., & Zumberge, M. A. (2016). Drift-corrected seafloor pressure observations of vertical deformation at Axial Seamount 2013–2014. Earth and Space Science, 3(9), 381–385.

entries.subject: The Self-Calibrating Pressure Recorder described by Sasagawa and Zumberge (2013)
facts: Its two Paroscientific model 410K quartz gauges, S/N 116504 (gauge 1) and S/N 118710 (gauge 2), drifted 0.52 kPa/year and 2.46 kPa/year in the paper's calibration records.

quotes.text: is 0.52 kPa/year for gauge 1 (S/N 116504) and 2.46 kPa/year for gauge 2 (S/N 118710).

source.citation: Sasagawa, G., & Zumberge, M. A. (2013). A self-calibrating pressure recorder for detecting seafloor height change. IEEE Journal of Oceanic Engineering, 38(3), 447–454.

entries.subject: A-0-A Calibrated Pressure Instrument at the Central Caldera
facts: It has two Paroscientific model 44.4K-302 pressure transducers, P1 and P2; the page prints SN136580 for both. (RCA Atlas note, not the page's: two transducers cannot share a serial number, so one of the two is misprinted.)
It also has a Paroscientific model 216B-102 barometer, a thermistor temperature sensor, and electronics made by RBR and integrated by UW-APL.

quotes.text: This A-0-A instrument includes two Paroscientific model 44.4K-302 pressure transducers (SN136580 is designated P1 and SN136580 is designated P2), a Paroscientific model 216B-102 barometer
a thermistor temperature sensor, and electronics manufactured by RBR and integrated by the UW-APL.

source.citation: Ocean Observatories Initiative. A-0-A Calibrated Pressure Instrument (web page).

entries.subject: Axial Base low-power junction box LJ03A, changed out on the 2017 cruise
facts: On the 2017 VISIONS cruise, ROV Jason dived to Axial Base to change out LJ03A, serial numbers SN011 and SN007 (blog of 1 August 2017, about the previous day).

quotes.text: August 1, 2017 Yesterday was a good day. Jason started the day with a dive to Axial Base to change out LJ03A – SN011 with LJ03A – SN007.

source.citation: Weertmans, W. (2017). Willem Weertmans' Blog, VISIONS'17, Interactive Oceans (web page).

entries.subject: Medium-power junction box serial number 024, in a COSZO project test record
facts: A secondary-node configuration sheet in the COSZO project's test records gives a Medium Power Junction Box, serial number 024, part number 4812-65244-020, for node MJ01B (the scan reads 'MJ0O1B').

quotes.text: Model ID Medium Power Junction Box Serial Number 024 Part Number 4812-65244-020 Manufacture Rev # MJ0O1B
